requiredOwnerEvidenceSegments.requirement: Exact owner commit/tree consumes the accepted launcher/SDK, branch scanner is zero, standard Wallet remains independent and all Web/Native transports obey their platform contract.
Exact public asset/runtime is commit/build/rollback-bound and directly proves provider/no-provider behavior without blank tabs, custom-scheme Web navigation or fabricated authority.
Real Wallet/provider proves account approval, exact approve/reject callback, cold-start recovery, replay/tamper rejection, Product Session lifecycle and explicit Retry with request IDs.
